Maharashtra's 701-Km Samruddhi Expressway Set For GIS-Led Development Around 20+ Interchanges

📅 2026-07-25 ✍️ Arun Dhital, Swarajya 🏷️ GIS, Maharashtra, Samruddhi Expressway, MSRDC, spatial planning, urban development, land use, interchange zones, India, infrastructure
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

The Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation has floated global tenders for a consultant to prepare GIS-based development plans for the zones surrounding 20+ interchanges on the 701-km Nagpur-Mumbai Samruddhi Expressway.

📌 Key takeaways

  • MSRDC has issued global tenders for a GIS consultant to prepare development plans for interchange influence zones along the 701-km Samruddhi Expressway
  • The consultant will prepare GIS base maps, conduct Existing Land Use (ELU) surveys, and draft GIS-based development plans
  • The expressway features over 20 interchanges, each measuring more than 40 acres, creating significant influence zones for planned development
  • A pre-bid meeting is scheduled for August 12, 2026, with proposals due by September 15, 2026, and an EMD of Rs 10 lakh
  • The initiative aims to enable orderly urban growth and sustainable land use along the key economic corridor linking Mumbai and Nagpur
